messages:
Priya: Quick FYI from my docs sweep — found a couple of KB pages that reference legacy S3 assets and a stale gist shortlink. Scanner flagged them but no owner in CODEOWNERS. Can someone pick these up so they don't fail in the next docs build?

Mark: Can you drop one example path so I can triage?

Priya: Example: /kb/runtime/connection-reset.md has `https://legacy-s3.redwood/diag/conn-reset.png` returning 403, and a line linking to `https://gist.github.com/olduser/abcd`. Curl: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`.

tim: I can take this one. Plan: rehost the image in /assets/docs/runtime, replace gist with an include snippet under snippets/runtime, and add frontmatter redirect for the shortlink. Local workflow: `rg "legacy-s3.redwood" docs/kb | sed -n '1,200p'` to find others, then `sed -i` replace on affected files.

docs-bot: Automated scanner: orphan-image detected in /kb/runtime/connection-reset.md (severity: low). No CODEOWNERS match.

Priya: Thanks tim. Two small requests: 1) add `alt` text on the image to satisfy a11y lint, 2) include a short caption so the docs UI shows context.

tim: Good call. I'll add `alt: "connection reset diag"` and `caption: "tcp conn reset during retry"`. ETA: PR by EOD.

infra-bot: Reminder: adding new asset paths may trigger bucket policy errors in CI. If docs CI fails with a 403 on upload, add `@infra` to the PR and request a one-off allowlist.

Mark: When you open the PR, tag me. Small nit: put snippet under `snippets/runtime/conn-reset.md` so our snippet tests pick it up.

tim: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5012 1 includes rehosted image, snippet migration, frontmatter redirect, alt + caption. Requesting review from @Mark and @Priya.

Priya: Reviewing now. Minor nit: can you add a changelog line under /docs/changelog/2026-03-21-kb-updates.md so we track these housekeeping fixes?

tim: Added changelog entry and addressed nit. CI docs build passed locally; leaving infra note in PR description in case it hits CI.

Mark: LGTM, approving. Thanks @tim.

Priya: Thanks all. If anyone else finds legacy-s3 references, paste them here and we'll batch a follow-up sweep. :+1:
